Senior Video Playback Engineer

Arcadia Streaming
  • Denver, CO

    • Arcadia Streaming is building the next generation of its video platform for millions of viewers on mobile, web and connected TV. We are hiring a Senior Video Playback Engineer to lead player architecture and bring AI-driven quality improvements to playback.

    Responsibilities

    • Lead the architecture of our cross-platform video player SDK across iOS, Android, Web, Roku, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS and Fire TV.
    • Own HLS and MPEG-DASH playback, adaptive bitrate (ABR) logic, DRM (Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady) and low-latency live streaming.
    • Improve Quality of Experience (QoE): startup time, rebuffering and playback failures, using telemetry and analytics.
    • Integrate client-side and server-side ad insertion (CSAI/SSAI) with VAST, VMAP and the Google IMA SDK.
    • Build backend microservices in Java, Python or Go on AWS that support playback and analytics.
    • Apply LLM-based AI agents to automate root-cause analysis of playback failures.
    • Mentor engineers and provide technical leadership across multiple teams.

    Required Qualifications

    • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building video players or streaming platforms.
    • Expert knowledge of HLS, MPEG-DASH, CMAF, DRM and adaptive bitrate streaming.
    • Experience with ExoPlayer or Android Media3, AVFoundation/AVPlayer, and Shaka Player or HLS.js.
    • Experience with distributed systems, microservices, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
    • Experience with CDN delivery (Akamai, CloudFront or Fastly) and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

    Preferred Qualifications

    • Experience with large language models (LLMs), AI agents and prompt engineering.
    • Experience with Roku SceneGraph and smart TV platforms.
    • Experience with GraphQL and React.

    Strong communication and collaboration skills. Arcadia Streaming is an equal opportunity employer.
